create_ObjectSampler: create an ObjectSampler to sample objects from a set and place them on receptacles in a Habitat simulator scene
sample_receptacle: sample a receptacle from the receptacle set with optional tilt culling and gravity alignment constraints
sample_placement: attempt to place a sampled object on a receptacle with collision testing and navmesh accessibility checks
single_sample: sample a single object placement by selecting a receptacle then an object and attempting placement
sample_multiple: run the full sampling loop to place multiple objects on receptacles with configurable min and max counts
